verdict.rationale: Poly is a file-storage and second-brain product. It has Markdown notes in its Mind folder, journaling, and imports from Obsidian and Notion, so block-level linking is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions referencing or transcluding a block or section of one note inside another, or keeping such references in sync. The docs cover search, version history (flashback), sharing, the CLI and MCP, none of which address this story.
